import collections
import math

int parse_integer(string text)
    return int(text)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

string clock_text(int minutes)
    return "{minutes / 60:02.}:{minutes % 60:02.}"

string[] day_names()
    return ["MO", "TU", "WE", "TH", "FR", "SA", "SU"]

int day_index(string name)
    names := day_names()
    for: 0 <= index < 7
        if names[index] == name
            return index
    return -1

class Slot(int day, int start, int end, string text)

bool overlaps(const Slot left, const Slot right)
    return left.day == right.day and left.start < right.end and right.start < left.end

Slot[] | error parse_slots(string text)
    Slot[] result := []
    if text == "-"
        return result
    for token := text.split(",")[]
        day := day_index(token[0:<2])
        start_hour := parse_integer(token[2:<4])
        start_minute := parse_integer(token[4:<6])
        end_hour := parse_integer(token[7:<9])
        end_minute := parse_integer(token[9:<11])
        start := 60 * start_hour + start_minute
        ending := 60 * end_hour + end_minute
        if day < 0 or start_hour > 23 or end_hour > 23 or start_minute > 59 or end_minute > 59 or start >= ending
            return error("invalid slot " + token)
        result = result.append(Slot(day, start, ending, token))
    for: 0 <= left < int(#result)
        for: left + 1 <= right < int(#result)
            if overlaps(result[left], result[right])
                return error("overlapping slots {result[left].text} {result[right].text}")
    return result

class Node(string kind, string word, int year, int left, int right, string canonical)
class Prerequisite(Node[] nodes, int root)
class Parser(string code, string source)
    position := 0
    Node[] nodes := []

int append_node(Parser &parser, const Node node)
    index := int(#parser.nodes)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(node)
    return index

bool course_word(string word)
    letters := 0
    while letters < int(#word) and "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(word[letters])
        letters += 1
    if letters < 2 or letters > 4 or int(#word) != letters + 3
        return false
    for: letters <= index < int(#word)
        if not "0123456789".contains(word[index])
            return false
    return true

int | error parse_expression(Parser &parser, int minimum)
    if parser.position >= int(#parser.source)
        return error("invalid prereq " + parser.code)
    int left
    if parser.source[parser.position] == "("
        parser.position += 1
        left = try parse_expression(&parser, 1)
        if parser.position == int(#parser.source) or parser.source[parser.position] != ")"
            return error("invalid prereq " + parser.code)
        parser.position += 1
    else
        first := parser.position
        while parser.position < int(#parser.source) and not "&|()".contains(parser.source[parser.position])
            parser.position += 1
        word := parser.source[first:<parser.position]
        if #word == 2 and word[0] == "Y" and "123456789".contains(word[1])
            left = append_node(&parser, Node("YEAR", word, parse_integer(word[1]), -1, -1, word))
        elif course_word(word)
            left = append_node(&parser, Node("COURSE", word, 0, -1, -1, word))
        else
            return error("invalid prereq " + parser.code)
    while parser.position < int(#parser.source)
        operation := parser.source[parser.position]
        precedence := if operation == "|" then 1 elif operation == "&" then 2 else 0
        if precedence < minimum
            break
        parser.position += 1
        right := try parse_expression(&parser, precedence + 1)
        first := parser.nodes[left]
        second := parser.nodes[right]
        first_text := if operation == "&" and first.kind == "|" then "(" + first.canonical + ")" else first.canonical
        second_text := if operation == "&" and second.kind == "|" then "(" + second.canonical + ")" else second.canonical
        left = append_node(&parser, Node(operation, "", 0, left, right, first_text + operation + second_text))
    return left

bool mentions(const Prerequisite prerequisite, string code)
    for node := prerequisite.nodes[]
        if node.kind == "COURSE" and node.word == code
            return true
    return false

Prerequisite | error parse_prerequisite(string code, string text)
    if text == "-"
        return Prerequisite([Node("NONE", "", 0, -1, -1, "-")], 0)
    parser := Parser(code, text)
    root := try parse_expression(&parser, 1)
    if parser.position != int(#text)
        return error("invalid prereq " + code)
    result := Prerequisite(parser.nodes, root)
    if mentions(result, code)
        return error("self prereq " + code)
    return result

string canonical(const Prerequisite prerequisite)
    return prerequisite.nodes[prerequisite.root].canonical

class Grade(string course, string letter, int credits, int points)
class History(int command, string event)
class Student(string id, int year, int limit, Grade[] grades)
    enrolled := distinct<int>()
    History[] history := []

class Course(string code, int credits, int capacity, Slot[] slots, Prerequisite prerequisite)
    registered := true
    open := true
    enrolled := distinct<int>()
    int[] waitlist := []

class State()
    Course[] courses := []
    Student[] students := []
    sequence := 0

int course_id(const State state, string code)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.courses)
        if state.courses[index].registered and state.courses[index].code == code
            return index
    return -1

int student_id(const State state, string id)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#state.students)
        if state.students[index].id == id
            return index
    return -1

int | error require_course(const State state, string code)
    index := course_id(state, code)
    if index < 0
        return error("unknown course " + code)
    return index

int | error require_student(const State state, string id)
    index := student_id(state, id)
    if index < 0
        return error("unknown student " + id)
    return index

Grade[] | error parse_grades(string id, string text)
    Grade[] result := []
    if text == "-"
        return result
    for token := text.split(",")[]
        parts := token.split(":")
        grade := parts[1]
        if not "ABCDF".contains(grade)
            return error("invalid grade {id} {parts[0]} {grade}")
        for previous := result[]
            if previous.course == parts[0]
                return error("duplicate record {id} {parts[0]}")
        points := if grade == "A" then 4 elif grade == "B" then 3 elif grade == "C" then 2 elif grade == "D" then 1 else 0
        result = result.append(Grade(parts[0], grade, parse_integer(parts[2]), points))
    return result

string passed_grade(const Student student, string code)
    for grade := student.grades[]
        if grade.course == code and grade.points >= 2
            return grade.letter
    return ""

bool satisfies(const Student student, const Prerequisite prerequisite)
    values := array(#prerequisite.nodes, fill = false)
    for: 0 <= index < int(#prerequisite.nodes)
        node := prerequisite.nodes[index]
        if node.kind == "NONE"
            values[index] = true
        elif node.kind == "YEAR"
            values[index] = student.year >= node.year
        elif node.kind == "COURSE"
            values[index] = passed_grade(student, node.word) != ""
        elif node.kind == "&"
            values[index] = values[node.left] and values[node.right]
        else
            values[index] = values[node.left] or values[node.right]
    return values[prerequisite.root]

int earned_credits(const Student student)
    credits := [for grade := student.grades[] if grade.letter != "F" then grade.credits]
    return credits.sum()

string gpa(const Student student)
    if #student.grades == 0
        return "n/a"
    credits := [for grade := student.grades[] then grade.credits]
    points := [for grade := student.grades[] then grade.points * grade.credits]
    rounded := (200 * points.sum() + credits.sum()) / (2 * credits.sum())
    return "{rounded / 100}.{rounded % 100:02.}"

int weekly_minutes(const Course course)
    lengths := [for slot := course.slots[] then slot.end - slot.start]
    return lengths.sum()

int[] course_order(const State state)
    names := [for course := state.courses[] if course.registered then course.code]
    return [for name := names.sorted()[] then course_id(state, name)]

int[] student_order(const State state)
    names := [for student := state.students[] then student.id]
    return [for name := names.sorted()[] then student_id(state, name)]

int[] enrolled_courses(const State state, int student_index)
    names := [for index := state.students[student_index].enrolled.values()[] then state.courses[index].code]
    return [for name := names.sorted()[] then course_id(state, name)]

int enrolled_credits(const State state, int student_index, excluded := -1)
    credits := [for index := state.students[student_index].enrolled.values()[] if index != excluded then state.courses[index].credits]
    return credits.sum()

int wait_position(const Course course, int student_index)
    for: 0 <= position < int(#course.waitlist)
        if course.waitlist[position] == student_index
            return position + 1
    return 0

int wait_count(const State state, int student_index)
    waiting := [for course := state.courses[] if course.registered and wait_position(course, student_index) > 0 then course]
    return int(#waiting)

int joining_position(const State state, int student_index, int course_index)
    ahead := [for index := state.courses[course_index].waitlist[] if state.students[index].year >= state.students[student_index].year then index]
    return 1 + int(#ahead)

bool courses_conflict(const Course left, const Course right)
    for first := left.slots[]
        for second := right.slots[]
            if overlaps(first, second)
                return true
    return false

string first_conflict(const State state, int student_index, int course_index, excluded := -1)
    for index := enrolled_courses(state, student_index)[]
        if index != excluded and courses_conflict(state.courses[index], state.courses[course_index])
            return state.courses[index].code
    return ""

class Judgment(string word, extra := "")

Judgment eligibility(const State state, int student_index, int course_index, excluded := -1)
    student := state.students[student_index]
    course := state.courses[course_index]
    if not course.open
        return Judgment("course closed")
    if course.enrolled.has(student_index)
        return Judgment("already enrolled")
    if wait_position(course, student_index) > 0
        return Judgment("already waitlisted")
    grade := passed_grade(student, course.code)
    if grade != ""
        return Judgment("already completed", grade)
    if not satisfies(student, course.prerequisite)
        return Judgment("prereq not met")
    conflict := first_conflict(state, student_index, course_index, excluded)
    if conflict != ""
        return Judgment("time conflict", conflict)
    credits := enrolled_credits(state, student_index, excluded) + course.credits
    if credits > student.limit
        return Judgment("credit limit", "{credits} {student.limit}")
    return Judgment("OK")

Judgment request(const State state, int student_index, int course_index)
    result := eligibility(state, student_index, course_index)
    if result.word != "OK"
        return result
    course := state.courses[course_index]
    if int(course.enrolled.size()) < course.capacity
        return Judgment("enroll")
    if wait_count(state, student_index) >= 3
        return Judgment("waitlist limit")
    return Judgment("waitlist", string(joining_position(state, student_index, course_index)))

string judgment_text(const Judgment judgment)
    return judgment.word + (if judgment.extra == "" then "" else " " + judgment.extra)

error request_error(const Judgment judgment, string student, string course)
    return error("{judgment.word} {student} {course}" + (if judgment.extra == "" then "" else " " + judgment.extra))

void history_event(State &state, int student_index, string event)
    state.students[student_index].history = state.students[student_index].history.append(History(state.sequence, event))

void add_enrollment(State &state, int student_index, int course_index)
    .state.courses[course_index].enrolled.add(student_index)
    .state.students[student_index].enrolled.add(course_index)

void remove_enrollment(State &state, int student_index, int course_index)
    .state.courses[course_index].enrolled.remove(student_index)
    .state.students[student_index].enrolled.remove(course_index)

void enrollment_notice(const State state, string verb, int student_index, int course_index)
    student := state.students[student_index]
    course := state.courses[course_index]
    emit("{verb} {student.id} {course.code} enrolled {course.enrolled.size()}/{course.capacity} credits {enrolled_credits(state, student_index)}/{student.limit}")

void promote(State &state)
    for course_index := course_order(state)[]
        if not state.courses[course_index].open
            continue
        while int(state.courses[course_index].enrolled.size()) < state.courses[course_index].capacity
            chosen := -1
            for student_index := state.courses[course_index].waitlist[]
                if first_conflict(state, student_index, course_index) == "" and enrolled_credits(state, student_index) + state.courses[course_index].credits <= state.students[student_index].limit
                    chosen = student_index
                    break
            if chosen < 0
                break
            state.courses[course_index].waitlist = [for index := state.courses[course_index].waitlist[] if index != chosen then index]
            add_enrollment(&state, chosen, course_index)
            history_event(&state, chosen, "promote " + state.courses[course_index].code)
            enrollment_notice(state, "  PROMOTE", chosen, course_index)

class Meeting(int day, int start, int end, string course)

Meeting[] sort_meetings(Meeting[] meetings)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#meetings)
        current := meetings[index]
        position := index
        while position > 0 and (meetings[position - 1].day > current.day or (meetings[position - 1].day == current.day and meetings[position - 1].start > current.start))
            meetings[position] = meetings[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        meetings[position] = current
    return meetings

Meeting[] student_meetings(const State state, int student_index)
    Meeting[] result := []
    for course_index := enrolled_courses(state, student_index)[]
        course := state.courses[course_index]
        for slot := course.slots[]
            result = result.append(Meeting(slot.day, slot.start, slot.end, course.code))
    return sort_meetings(result)

void show_schedule(const State state, int student_index)
    student := state.students[student_index]
    enrolled := enrolled_courses(state, student_index)
    weekly := [for index := enrolled[] then weekly_minutes(state.courses[index])]
    emit("SCHEDULE {student.id} courses {#enrolled} credits {enrolled_credits(state, student_index)} weekly {clock_text(weekly.sum())}")
    meetings := student_meetings(state, student_index)
    days := day_names()
    for: 0 <= day < 7
        parts := [for meeting := meetings[] if meeting.day == day then "{clock_text(meeting.start)}-{clock_text(meeting.end)} {meeting.course}"]
        if #parts > 0
            emit("  " + days[day] + " " + parts.join(" "))
    unspecified := [for index := enrolled[] if #state.courses[index].slots == 0 then state.courses[index].code]
    if #unspecified > 0
        emit("  TBA " + unspecified.join(" "))

void show_free(const State state, int student_index, int day)
    cursor := 480
    total := 0
    string[] ranges := []
    for meeting := student_meetings(state, student_index)[]
        if meeting.day == day and meeting.end > 480 and meeting.start < 1320
            if meeting.start > cursor
                total += meeting.start - cursor
                ranges = ranges.append("{clock_text(cursor)}-{clock_text(meeting.start)}")
            cursor = math.max(cursor, math.min(1320, meeting.end))
    if cursor < 1320
        total += 1320 - cursor
        ranges = ranges.append("{clock_text(cursor)}-22:00")
    days := day_names()
    emit("FREE {state.students[student_index].id} {days[day]} total {clock_text(total)}" + (if #ranges == 0 then "" else " " + ranges.join(" ")))

void show_audit(const State state, int student_index)
    student := state.students[student_index]
    emit("AUDIT {student.id} year {student.year} limit {student.limit}")
    records := [for grade := student.grades[] then grade.course]
    for code := records.sorted()[]
        for grade := student.grades[]
            if grade.course == code
                emit("  record {code} {grade.letter} {grade.credits}")
    emit("  earned {earned_credits(student)} gpa {gpa(student)}")
    for index := enrolled_courses(state, student_index)[]
        emit("  enrolled {state.courses[index].code} {state.courses[index].credits}")
    credits := enrolled_credits(state, student_index)
    emit("  credits {credits} remaining {student.limit - credits}")
    for index := course_order(state)[]
        position := wait_position(state.courses[index], student_index)
        if position > 0
            emit("  waitlist {state.courses[index].code} {position}")

string enrollment_rate(int count, int capacity)
    return if capacity == 0 then "n/a" else string(count * 100 / capacity) + "%"

string department(string code)
    return code[0:<int(#code) - 3]

string aggregate(const State state, const int[] indices)
    enrolled := [for index := indices[] then int(state.courses[index].enrolled.size())]
    capacities := [for index := indices[] then state.courses[index].capacity]
    waits := [for index := indices[] then int(#state.courses[index].waitlist)]
    return "courses {#indices} enrolled {enrolled.sum()}/{capacities.sum()} rate {enrollment_rate(enrolled.sum(), capacities.sum())} waitlisted {waits.sum()}"

void show_report(const State state)
    indices := course_order(state)
    emit("REPORT " + aggregate(state, indices))
    distinct<string> departments
    for index := indices[]
        course := state.courses[index]
        status := if course.open then "open" else "closed"
        emit("  {course.code} {status} {course.enrolled.size()}/{course.capacity} {enrollment_rate(int(course.enrolled.size()), course.capacity)} waitlist {#course.waitlist}")
        .departments.add(department(course.code))
    for name := departments.sorted()[]
        selected := [for index := indices[] if department(state.courses[index].code) == name then index]
        emit("  dept {name} " + aggregate(state, selected))

void | error command(State &state, const string[] words)
    verb := words[0]
    if verb == "COURSE"
        code := words[1]
        if course_id(state, code) >= 0
            return error("duplicate course " + code)
        slots := try parse_slots(words[4])
        prerequisite := try parse_prerequisite(code, words[5])
        course := Course(code, parse_integer(words[2]), parse_integer(words[3]), slots, prerequisite)
        state.courses = state.courses.append(course)
        emit("COURSE {code} credits {course.credits} capacity {course.capacity} meetings {#slots} weekly {clock_text(weekly_minutes(course))} prereq {canonical(prerequisite)}")
    elif verb == "STUDENT"
        id := words[1]
        if student_id(state, id) >= 0
            return error("duplicate student " + id)
        grades := try parse_grades(id, words[4])
        student := Student(id, parse_integer(words[2]), parse_integer(words[3]), grades)
        state.students = state.students.append(student)
        emit("STUDENT {id} year {student.year} limit {student.limit} records {#grades} earned {earned_credits(student)} gpa {gpa(student)}")
    elif verb == "ENROLL" or verb == "CHECK" or verb == "DROP" or verb == "SWAP"
        student_index := try require_student(state, words[1])
        course_index := try require_course(state, words[2])
        course := state.courses[course_index]
        if verb == "ENROLL" or verb == "CHECK"
            judgment := request(state, student_index, course_index)
            if verb == "CHECK"
                emit("CHECK {words[1]} {words[2]} {judgment_text(judgment)}")
            elif judgment.word == "enroll"
                add_enrollment(&state, student_index, course_index)
                history_event(&state, student_index, "enroll " + course.code)
                enrollment_notice(state, "ENROLL", student_index, course_index)
            elif judgment.word == "waitlist"
                position := parse_integer(judgment.extra) - 1
                state.courses[course_index].waitlist = course.waitlist[0:<position].append(student_index).concat(course.waitlist[position:])
                history_event(&state, student_index, "waitlist {course.code} {position + 1}")
                emit("ENROLL {words[1]} {course.code} waitlist {position + 1}")
            else
                return request_error(judgment, words[1], course.code)
        elif verb == "DROP"
            if course.enrolled.has(student_index)
                remove_enrollment(&state, student_index, course_index)
                history_event(&state, student_index, "drop " + course.code)
                enrollment_notice(state, "DROP", student_index, course_index)
            elif wait_position(course, student_index) > 0
                state.courses[course_index].waitlist = [for index := course.waitlist[] if index != student_index then index]
                history_event(&state, student_index, "drop " + course.code + " waitlist")
                emit("DROP {words[1]} {course.code} waitlist removed")
            else
                return error("not registered {words[1]} {course.code}")
            promote(&state)
        else
            destination := try require_course(state, words[3])
            if not course.enrolled.has(student_index)
                return error("not enrolled {words[1]} {course.code}")
            if course_index == destination
                return error("same course " + course.code)
            judgment := eligibility(state, student_index, destination, course_index)
            if judgment.word != "OK"
                return request_error(judgment, words[1], words[3])
            if int(state.courses[destination].enrolled.size()) >= state.courses[destination].capacity
                return error("course full " + words[3])
            remove_enrollment(&state, student_index, course_index)
            add_enrollment(&state, student_index, destination)
            history_event(&state, student_index, "swap {words[2]} {words[3]}")
            emit("SWAP {words[1]} {words[2]} -> {words[3]} credits {enrolled_credits(state, student_index)}/{state.students[student_index].limit}")
            promote(&state)
    elif verb == "CLOSE" or verb == "OPEN" or verb == "CAPACITY" or verb == "PREREQ" or verb == "CANCEL" or verb == "ROSTER" or verb == "INFO"
        course_index := try require_course(state, words[1])
        course := state.courses[course_index]
        status := if course.open then "open" else "closed"
        if verb == "CLOSE" or verb == "OPEN"
            opening := verb == "OPEN"
            if opening == course.open
                return error("already {status} {course.code}")
            state.courses[course_index].open = opening
            emit("{verb} {course.code} enrolled {course.enrolled.size()}/{course.capacity} waitlist {#course.waitlist}")
            if opening
                promote(&state)
        elif verb == "CAPACITY"
            capacity := parse_integer(words[2])
            if capacity < int(course.enrolled.size())
                return error("capacity below enrollment {course.code} {course.enrolled.size()}")
            state.courses[course_index].capacity = capacity
            emit("CAPACITY {course.code} {course.capacity} -> {capacity}")
            promote(&state)
        elif verb == "PREREQ"
            prerequisite := try parse_prerequisite(course.code, words[2])
            state.courses[course_index].prerequisite = prerequisite
            emit("PREREQ {course.code} {canonical(prerequisite)}")
            int[] retained := []
            for student_index := course.waitlist[]
                if satisfies(state.students[student_index], prerequisite)
                    retained = retained.append(student_index)
                else
                    history_event(&state, student_index, "unlist " + course.code)
                    emit("  UNLIST {state.students[student_index].id} {course.code}")
            state.courses[course_index].waitlist = retained
        elif verb == "CANCEL"
            emit("CANCEL {course.code} enrolled {course.enrolled.size()} waitlist {#course.waitlist}")
            for student_index := course.enrolled.values()[]
                .state.students[student_index].enrolled.remove(course_index)
                history_event(&state, student_index, "cancel " + course.code)
            for student_index := course.waitlist[]
                history_event(&state, student_index, "cancel " + course.code + " waitlist")
            state.courses[course_index].registered = false
            state.courses[course_index].enrolled = distinct<int>()
            state.courses[course_index].waitlist = []
            promote(&state)
        elif verb == "ROSTER"
            emit("ROSTER {course.code} {status} enrolled {course.enrolled.size()}/{course.capacity} waitlist {#course.waitlist}")
            ids := [for index := course.enrolled.values()[] then state.students[index].id]
            for id := ids.sorted()[]
                student := state.students[student_id(state, id)]
                emit("  enrolled {id} year {student.year}")
            for: 0 <= position < int(#course.waitlist)
                student := state.students[course.waitlist[position]]
                emit("  waitlist {position + 1} {student.id} year {student.year}")
        else
            emit("INFO {course.code} {status} credits {course.credits} capacity {course.capacity} prereq {canonical(course.prerequisite)}")
            meetings := [for slot := course.slots[] then Meeting(slot.day, slot.start, slot.end, course.code)]
            days := day_names()
            for meeting := sort_meetings(meetings)[]
                emit("  meet {days[meeting.day]} {clock_text(meeting.start)}-{clock_text(meeting.end)}")
            if #meetings == 0
                emit("  meet TBA")
            dependents := [for candidate := state.courses[] if candidate.registered and mentions(candidate.prerequisite, course.code) then candidate.code]
            emit("  required by " + (if #dependents == 0 then "none" else dependents.sorted().join(" ")))
    elif verb == "STUDENTS"
        emit("STUDENTS {#state.students}")
        for student_index := student_order(state)[]
            student := state.students[student_index]
            emit("  {student.id} year {student.year} credits {enrolled_credits(state, student_index)}/{student.limit} courses {student.enrolled.size()} waitlists {wait_count(state, student_index)}")
    elif verb == "REPORT"
        show_report(state)
    else
        student_index := try require_student(state, words[1])
        student := state.students[student_index]
        if verb == "OPTIONS"
            indices := course_order(state)
            emit("OPTIONS {student.id} courses {#indices}")
            for index := indices[]
                emit("  {state.courses[index].code} {judgment_text(request(state, student_index, index))}")
        elif verb == "LIMIT"
            limit := parse_integer(words[2])
            credits := enrolled_credits(state, student_index)
            if limit < credits
                return error("limit below enrolled {student.id} {credits}")
            state.students[student_index].limit = limit
            emit("LIMIT {student.id} {student.limit} -> {limit}")
            promote(&state)
        elif verb == "SCHEDULE"
            show_schedule(state, student_index)
        elif verb == "FREE"
            day := day_index(words[2])
            if day < 0
                return error("invalid day " + words[2])
            show_free(state, student_index, day)
        elif verb == "AUDIT"
            show_audit(state, student_index)
        else
            emit("HISTORY {student.id} events {#student.history}")
            for entry := student.history[]
                emit("  {entry.command} {entry.event}")
    return void

state := State()
int count
scan(&count)
for: 1 <= sequence <= count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    state.sequence = sequence
    match command(&state, line.split(" "))
        void
            continue
        error problem
            emit("ERROR " + problem.message)
